answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the opal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the jetty is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
